tools.name: best_crossing
tools.description: Which bridge or port in a city has the shortest car line right now. Ranks open crossings by their published live standard-lane wait (estimates, frozen and stale readings are left out). In el-paso, best is chosen among the in-town bridges (Puente Libre, Zaragoza, Santa Fe; Libre wins a tie); Tornillo

tools.name: best_time_to_cross
tools.description: Historical pattern, not live data: average and peak waits, best and worst day of the week, best hour, per bridge. Use for 'when is the line shortest', 'best time to cross', 'best day', 'cuándo hay menos fila'. Every city: el-paso uses the site's published number; the other cities use CBP's car-lane

tools.name: wait_history
tools.description: Hourly standard (car) lane averages for one Juárez–El Paso bridge, newest hour first. Use for 'is it getting better or worse'. Slugs: santa-fe, puente-libre, lerdo, zaragoza, tornillo, santa-teresa.

tools.name: border_news
tools.description: Latest border news stories from filadepuentes.com/noticias, aggregated from ~48 Mexican and US outlets and summarized in Spanish. Use for 'what is happening at the border / at the bridges today'. Optional city filter. Each story has a url.

tools.name: answer_wait_question
tools.description: Turn a natural-language question like '¿cuánta fila hay en Santa Fe?' or 'how long is the San Ysidro line?' into a ready-to-post answer with live numbers (CBP data plus community reports, on every crossing) and a link. Detects the city and bridge from the question. Returns {reply, data, source_url}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_bridge · Private data: border_knowledge · Public sink: answer_wait_question, watch_bridge · Destructive: best_time_to_cross.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_bridge · Private data: border_knowledge · Public sink: answer_wait_question, watch_bridge · Destructive: best_time_to_cross

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
